name: SpaceCorps XXX
source:
The war between the Interstellar Union and the Cervaxian Empire has raged for twenty years...

To defend the Motherland from the alien menace, every Union citizen must join SpaceCorps the day they turn nineteen...

Today is your nineteenth birthday...

You play as a naïve young farmhand from Ganymede, thrust into an exciting (and rather raunchy) galaxy when you're conscripted into SpaceCorps. Meet the training crew of the USS Mercury - a rag-tag of gorgeous aliens, sexy cyborgs and predatory milfs. Seduce your beautiful fellow cadets in an ongoing dating-sim to see just how close you can all get. Visit strange new worlds and new civilizations with very different moral codes.

Your path is open for you to choose. Help a self-aware AI find out what it feels like to be human; or find out just what connection the strict Drill Sergeant has to your past. Seduce your childhood sweetheart; or humiliate your school bully. Explore kinks you never even knew you had!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/RanliLabz]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
星际联盟与瑟瓦克西亚帝国之间的战争，已经持续了20年……

为了保卫家园、抵御外星威胁，每一位联盟公民都必须在年满19岁的当天加入太空军团……

今天，就是你的19岁生日……

你将扮演一名来自木卫三、天真懵懂的年轻农场工人。征召入伍后，你被推入了一个充满刺激，也颇为放荡的银河世界。在联盟星舰“水星号”上，认识形形色色的训练人员吧：美艳的外星人、性感的改造人，以及如狼似虎的熟女。在持续展开的恋爱模拟中，追求那些美丽的学员同伴，看看你们究竟能亲密到什么程度。探索陌生的新世界，接触道德观念截然不同的新文明。

前路任你选择。帮助一名拥有自我意识的AI体会身而为人的感觉，或是查明那位严厉的训练教官与你的过去究竟有何关联。追求青梅竹马，或是羞辱曾经在学校霸凌你的人。探索那些连你自己都未曾察觉的性癖！
